subject: Service resume attestation, RTO test traces and runbook excerpts
messages:
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acme-payments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and runbook excerpts for SIG assessment

Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Acme's SIG review we need a compact package demonstrating your BCP/DR capabilities focused on the following items:

- An excerpt of the operational runbook that covers a full-region service resume (play-by-play)
- RTO and RPO measurements from the most recent scheduled restore exercise (raw traces preferred)
- A short attestation (signed) describing who owns restore authorization and the escalation chain
- Any SOC 2 evidence mapping for the above artifacts (control IDs or exhibit refs)

Can you provide the artifacts or point us at a secure share? If possible we need: one sample restore trace (scrubbed of customer data), a CSV of measured RTO/RPO times, and a 1-page attestation we can attach to the SIG questionnaire.

We have a SIG deadline next week (2027-07-07). Appreciate ETA on delivery and whether you prefer a quick call to walk through the traces.

Thanks,
Jorge
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and runbook excerpts for SIG assessment

Jorge — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the requested package by EOD today with the following contents:

- Redwood_Runbook_Excerpt_v2.pdf (pages showing region failover, restore authorization flow, and clean-up steps)
- restore_traces_20270512.log (single sample from our May 12 scheduled restore; scrubbed of tenant identifiers)
- rto_rpo_measurements_20270512.csv (per-test measurements, median and 95th percentile listed)
- BCP_Attestation_Acme_20270630.pdf (signed attestation describing ownership and escalation)

Notes: our measured median RTO for that restore was ~4m20s; 95th percentile 7m45s. RPO is sub-second for metadata and <30s for persisted KV snapshot restores (details in CSV). I'll also include control refs for our SOC 2 evidence pack (control IDs in the runbook footer).

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with Ops (Ben and Laura) at 14:00 ET today — that will let us step through the trace live. Otherwise, the Drive link and the attestation PDF will suffice for SIG submission.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Trust & Safety (vendor escalation)
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and runbook excerpts for SIG assessment

Ben/Laura — forwarding Acme's ask. Quick action items: 

- Ben: prepare the scrubbed trace (restore_traces_20270512.log) and stamp it with the test id. Remove tenant ids and any PII. Put on the shared secure Drive folder and add me as owner.
- Laura: export the per-step timestamps into a CSV and compute median/95th; put summary row at top of rto_rpo_measurements_20270512.csv. Include method notes (how timestamp is measured).
- Priyom: confirm the RPO characterization for KV snapshots and add the control mapping lines for SOC 2 evidence (highlight CC6 and CC7 equivalents).

We'll assemble and push to Jorge; target ship by 15:00 ET. If any blocker, please call.

On Wed, 30 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acme-payments.com> wrote:
> Soojin,
>
> As part of Acme's SIG review we need a compact package demonstrating your BCP/DR capabilities focused on the following items: ...

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and runbook excerpts for SIG assessment

Jorge — attaching the requested artifacts and a short summary below. All files are available on the secure Drive link (access granted to your security mailbox). Attachment list below; Drive link and DocuSign attestation are also included.

Attachments: Redwood_Runbook_Excerpt_v2.pdf (excerpt of the service resume playbook)
             restore_traces_20270512.log (scrubbed trace sample)
             rto_rpo_measurements_20270512.csv (per-step timings + summary stats)
             BCP_Attestation_Acme_20270630.pdf (signed attestation)

Quick summary:
- Median measured RTO (restore start → service healthy): 4 minutes 20 seconds
- 95th percentile RTO: 7 minutes 45 seconds
- RPO: metadata replication is sub-second; full KV snapshot incremental restore median: 18 seconds (95th percentile 42s)
- Restore authorization: Tier-2 oncall confirms, Tier-3 (ops lead) signs off for cross-region restores — see attestation PDF for names and signatures
- SOC 2 mapping: control refs are included in the runbook footer (CC6.1, CC7.3 equivalents), and Priyom has validated the mapping for SIG fields in the CSV notes column.

If you'd like the 14:00 ET walkthrough still, Ben and Laura can join and step through the log with timestamps highlighted — otherwise please confirm receipt and we'll mark this as delivered for the SIG packet.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-bcp (access granted)
DocuSign: DOCUSIGN:envelope-0a9f3c2d

Regards,
Soojin
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

--
